Interesting facts
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Winter's price was 102,500 crystals and was obtainable at the rank of Lieutenant Colonel.
Legacy paint description:
An all-around paint that gives minimal protection against Firebird and Railgun, average protection against Thunder, and great protection against Shaft. Works well at any range. Sports a natural masking texture that makes the tank harder to spot.
The paint was added to containers on January 14th, 2022.
